rows.jyutping: jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 gam2 V
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action or claim is carried out in a believable, convincing way.

example.english: They explained the whole matter credibly, and everyone was convinced.
example.traditional: 佢有說服力噉解釋成件事，大家都信服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 gam2 gaai2 sik1 sing4 gin6 si6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 seon3 fuk6

rows.jyutping: teng1 ho2 kaau3 siu1 sik1 gong2
rows.note: Use this when reporting something said by a source that the speaker considers reliable, rather than describing how an action is performed.

example.english: Credibly, the company will move next month.
example.traditional: 聽可靠消息講，間公司下個月會搬。
example.jyutping: teng1 ho2 kaau3 siu1 sik1 gong2 gaan1 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 bun1
